bullets.text: The Velachery flyover project remains in limbo after the foundation stone was laid and CMRL confirmed project integration is not feasible, so the office should monitor corporation actions.
Chennai Traffic Police announced traffic diversions in Adambakkam for five days starting November 11 for sewage pipeline work, and the office should watch public inconvenience.
New model corridor plans are being developed on Taramani, Velachery, and Tambaram roads to address traffic congestion, and the office should track implementation progress.
Birders recorded multiple white wagtail sightings at Pallikaranai during the early migratory season, and the office should watch environmental preservation efforts.
The second day of the Kanda Sashti festival was celebrated at the Thiruttani Murugan temple with special rituals, and the office should monitor crowd management.
An ancient Perumal statue found on government poramboke land in Ponneri was handed over to the treasury, and the office should watch further archaeological inquiries.
The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet approved new AI, robotics, and electronics policies alongside a major Vizag data centre, and our portfolio team should monitor regional tech developments.
MeitY launched the DEPA for AI training handbook to advance trusted data collaboration, and our office should review the framework for state implementation.
The Greater Chennai Corporation removed 567.41 metric tonnes of firecracker waste across Chennai, and the digital services team should track municipal cleanup reporting.
BJP leader Nainar Nagendran issued a statement condemning the state government over the Gingee girl missing case, and the political team should monitor developments.

stories.title: Velachery Flyover In Limbo After Laying Foundation Stone
takeaways: The Rs 310-crore Velachery flyover project remains stalled as CMRL ruled out integrating the two ongoing infrastructure works together.
The Chennai Corporation can now proceed independently with the flyover construction after the transit feasibility review concluded.
